text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. In order to better co-ordinate with current pick-up/drop-off times at Withrow Avenue Public School, Transportation Services is requesting approval to amend the current hours of operation of the 10-minute student pick-up/drop-off zone located on Bain Avenue, between Broadview Avenue and Ingham Avenue. To enhance safety during pick-up/drop-off times, and deter students from crossing the roadway, Transportation Services is also requesting approval to relocate this 10-minute parking zone from the north side of Bain Avenue to the south side of the street, fronting the school.
